title: Santa Cruz on Flores, the westernmost of the Azores, becomes a settlement of the crown: 1,300 Andalusī settlers

By 1423 the heir's sons are married. Ismāʿīl has taken three princesses of the three Muslim empires around him: Tella of Fās, sister of the sultan Yaḥyā; Ayaulym of Miṣr, daughter of the Mamlūk sultan Aqṭāy; and Khadīja, daughter of the Ottoman sultan Aḥmad. His brother Aḥmad has married Dīma of the Ḥafṣids of Tūnis, Muʾmina of Burtuqāl and ʿĀʾisha bint Saʿd. Their first children are born in 1422
